europe_now.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships
europe_now.summary: Putin has threatened to seize European ships, escalating tensions with European nations. This move represents a significant security concern for European maritime operations and could impact regional stability.

sources.headline: Putin threatens to seize European ships

europe_now.title: Ukraine hammers key Russian port in overnight drone attack
europe_now.summary: Ukraine conducted a drone attack on a key Russian port overnight, targeting critical infrastructure. This strike demonstrates Ukraine's ongoing capability to project military force deep into Russian territory.

sources.headline: Ukraine hammers key Russian port in overnight drone attack

top_stories.title: Ukraine Conflict Intensifies
top_stories.summary: The conflict between Russia and Ukraine continues to escalate with renewed missile strikes and civilian casualties. Both sides are experiencing intensified military engagements across multiple fronts.
